text:
Sam (Support): Escalation: Vertex Labs (tenant=vertex-eval-5) onboarding blocked. Their embedding imports are returning 502s and SSO is failing with 403. They have a customer demo in ~6h and renewal/expand check in 7 days. Need CS lead + immediate mitigation + comms. :rotating_light:
Ivy (CS): Taking point. Drop the error snippets + any tenant quota or trace info here and I'll spin up a remediation call + external note.
Sam (Support): Error snippets:
```
POST /v1/embeddings 502
{"error":"upstream_read_timeout","request_id":"req_vtx_77"}
Trace: embed-proxy -> auth-gateway -> worker-timeout
```
```
SSO login -> 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","request_id":"req_sso_44"}
Trace: sso-proxy -> claim-check -> deny
```
Sam (Support): Also seeing repeated token-exchange failures in auth logs right before the 502s.
Kai (Eng): Quick triage: looks like two partially related issues. (1) Auth gateway returning 403 on SSO due to missing audience claim in token -> blocks demo flows that hit our embed pipeline. (2) Embedding workers hit transient timeouts from an overloaded worker shard. Short-term fixes: A) apply a token-audience fallback for that tenant so SSO flows don't fail, B) route tenant to a lower-load worker pool, C) bump tenant request quota for the demo window. I can flip routing + apply audience-fallback now if CS signs off. Command: `redwoodctl tenant set vertex-eval-5 --route=us-west-lowload --auth-aud-fallback=true`
Nora (AM): Demo is public and invitations sent. If we don't fix this, renewal and expansion are at risk. Approve remedial actions including a goodwill credit if needed.
Ivy (CS): Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate: apology + 20m triage call with Support+Eng within 30m. 2) If mitigation holds: 30m remediation with customer and offer $650 credit + a free co-run enablement session. 3) Post-call: update renewal brief and flag for proactive outreach in 5 days. Nora ok on credit? :memo:
Nora (AM): Approve $650 credit + co-run. Use wording: "We're sorry for the disruption. We've applied a mitigation and will credit $650 to your account and offer a live co-run for your demo." Approved. :+1:
Sam (Support): Reached out to customer; they can do a triage call in 25 minutes. Attached SSO admin contact and sample ingest manifest.
Kai (Eng): I applied the auth-audience fallback and routed vertex-eval-5 to us-west-lowload. Observability shows SSO errors dropping and embed 502s decreasing. I'll hold routing for 4 hours and open PRs for better token validation error detail and worker shard autoscale.
SignalBot: Incident logged INC-3188-200; severity=high; assignees=Ivy (CS), Kai (Eng); created_at=3220012352
Ivy (CS): Running the triage call now. Goals: validate demo path, hand off sample ingest scripts, confirm SSO provisioning, and capture any product gaps to ops.
Sam (Support): Customer asked for a Node + Python ingest sample and a brief SSO checklist. I'll upload examples to the ticket.
Marta (Security): Heads-up: audience-fallback is a temporary exception; please capture the token traces and confirm the customer consents to the fallback for the demo window. We'll need to revoke the fallback after stability and log the decision in the security exception tracker.
Ivy (CS): Noted. I'll get verbal consent on the triage call and file the security exception. Also will request the customer to use sanitized data for the public demo.
Kai (Eng): Follow-ups: open PR for improved auth error codes, add shard autoscale rule for heavy ingest windows, and schedule a midnight hotfix if needed. I'll revert route and auth fallback after 24h stable.
Ivy (CS): Call complete  workaround validated end-to-end, demo path exercised. Customer appreciated the rapid response. Sending remediation email now and scheduling follow-up in 3 days. Marking renewal as watch until next-week follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Support): Thanks team  leaving ticket open until follow-up confirmed. I'll attach the logs + CI job timeline.
Ivy (CS): CRM comms snippet: "Vertex Labs onboarding hit SSO 403s and embedding 502s due to token audience mismatch + overloaded embed shard. Temporary audience-fallback + pool routing mitigated the issue during validation. Actions: $650 credit + live co-run offered; SSO checklist and ingest samples delivered; eng fixes queued (auth error detail PR + shard autoscale). Renewal flagged for outreach in 5 days. Contacts: Ivy (CS), Nora (AM)."
Nora (AM): Acknowledged. I'll update the renewal brief and reach out in 5 days with the remediation summary.
